about_the_game:
Casa Caballero is a single-player, first-person survival horror game set in a fictional area in the Philippines.

When your colleagues failed to return from their assignment, you are tasked to look for them in a house filled with secrets… and keeps its visitors lost within its walls.

Uncover the mysteries of Casa Caballero and its residents through notes scattered across the property. Keep your eyes open for clues and items to solve puzzles and unlock new areas.

Armed with only a pistol, you must fight off the horrors lurking in the house while evading those that cannot be killed.

Prepare for an immersive experience that will test your problem-solving skills as you strive to escape Casa Caballero in one piece.

Game Features:

  • Realistic Graphics

  • Engaging puzzle-solving

  • Occasional first-person shooting

  • Setting and story inspired by Philippine history, culture, and folklore

The approximate duration of the game is 1-2 hours.

content_descriptors.notes: The game depicts violence and gore, including mutilation of a corpse. There is an implied use of alcohol and cigarettes.

short_description: A city hall surveyor searches for their missing colleagues in a bahay-na-bato, only to uncover sinister secrets tied to Philippine history and folklore. Explore items and records, solve puzzles, and face enemies as you unravel the mysteries within and beyond the property walls
